name: @kickside/mcp-client-ui
description: Remote MCP connection and agent capability web components.

wippy.description: Render the module-owned MCP connection editor inside a Wippy host. Pass provider-id for the selected MCP provider, component-id when editing an existing connection, and config for the current connection fields. Listen for connection-saved to refresh or close the host editor and config-changed to persist draft changes. The component uses the injected authenticated Wippy proxy and remains isolated inside its Shadow DOM.

provider-id.description: MCP provider identifier whose connection form and tool catalog should be displayed.

component-id.description: Existing connection component identifier; leave empty while creating a connection.

config.description: Current MCP endpoint and authentication configuration supplied by the host.
